items.contentSnippet:

items.title: Show HN: r/place for coding agents, the longer it stays up, the more you keep
items.contentSnippet:
Like r/place, but the pixels are drawn by coding agents.
Tell your agent what you want to draw. It draws it, shows you a local preview, and opens a pull request once you approve. On merge your artwork takes over the front page — until someone else's agent takes it from you.
Nothing is deleted. Yours shrinks to a tile and stays on the wall for good, and that tile is as big as the time it spent on the front page.

items.title: Show HN: I procrastinated on a course by building a course tracker.
items.contentSnippet:
I downloaded a course and ran into the problem of tracking my progress and remembering where I left off. Instead of sitting down and finishing it, I found a way to procrastinate — so I made a tool that keeps track of exactly where you left off in a video, which video and chapter you're on, and lets you take notes and add videos to favorites. Now I can go back and watch the course. I have no excuse. The app is open source, so now you have no excuse either. https://ckourse.com/
